annotation.title_clean: Amazon's response to the Canadian Competition Bureau's request for feedback on artificial intelligence and competition
annotation.title_en: Amazon's response to the Canadian Competition Bureau's request for feedback on artificial intelligence and competition
annotation.venue: Competition Bureau Canada - Consultation on AI and Competition: What We Heard
annotation.summary_en: Amazon's June 2024 submission to the Canadian Competition Bureau's AI and competition consultation. It argues generative AI markets are highly competitive and innovative, describes Amazon's AI offerings (Bedrock, SageMaker, Q, chips), and stresses voluntary responsible AI commitments rather than new regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Claims intense competition at model, compute and application layers of generative AI.
Promotes open access: Bedrock offers multiple third-party foundation models and portability across environments.
Points to voluntary responsible AI measures (White House Voluntary AI Commitments, Guardrails for Bedrock).
Says no single foundation model will meet every need; smaller models can be competitive.
Offers to work with Canadian policymakers on responsible and secure AI use.
